comment: Flagged-reason cases. Each case is a linear history (every event sees all earlier ones, unless its step [stream, type, payload, origin, seen] names its own seen, for a concurrent write) on the genesis below; every step but the last must apply, and the last is flagged with the expected reason. gen-golden.js runs each case through the reference engine and fails when its reason differs; goOnly cases are skipped there, engineOnly cases (the roles.add_member stand-in, which Go does not port) by the Go test.
